node.text: Proud to be recognised by the PORTVILLE BUSINESS AWARDS as one of the top 30 young founders in the region 🎉

At 18, I told the owner of the café where I worked summers that I wouldn’t be back next year. He’d offered me a shift lead role, decent pay for a teenager. I said no, I told him I was going to start something of my own.

No car. No savings. Just a tram card, an old laptop, and a plan nobody else could picture yet.

Some years later, I choose my hours and my desk; Close to 20 countries. More weeks away than at home this year. Over €2 million in pipeline built for the teams I work with. Doing the things that used to sit on a list called “someday.”

Someday arrived quietly. It looked like an ordinary Wednesday.
